title: Survival of the Fittest Perturbations: Uncertainty-Aware Evolution of Adversarial Distributions for Robust Generalization
abstract: arXiv:2411.02871v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Despite deep learning's broad successes across diverse scenarios, its vulnerability to adversarial examples impedes deployment, making adversarial training a leading approach to improve robustness. However, pointwise adversarial training maps each clean sample to a single adversary, overlooking surrounding adversarial variability and the associated shifts in feature statistics. To address these issues, we propose Evolutionary Uncertainty-Aware Distributional Adversarial Training (EvoUAD-AT). Specifically, we design an evolutionary adversarial uncertainty modeling module that maintains an instance-wise search distribution over adversarial feature statistics around an adversarially generated anchor. Candidates are evaluated under the current model, selected by their threat to a benign reference, and used to adapt the distribution; strategy parameters are retained across epochs. translated_title: 适者生存的扰动：面向鲁棒泛化的对抗分布不确定性感知演化
translated_abstract: 尽管深度学习在多种场景中取得了广泛的成功，但其对对抗样本的脆弱性阻碍了实际部署，这使得对抗训练成为提升模型鲁棒性的主流方法。然而，逐点对抗训练将每个干净样本映射为单个对抗样本，忽略了周围的对抗变异性以及由此引起的特征统计偏移。为解决这些问题，我们提出了进化式不确定性感知分布对抗训练（EvoUAD-AT）。具体而言，我们设计了一个进化式对抗不确定性建模模块，该模块在对抗生成的锚点周围维护一个针对对抗特征统计的实例级搜索分布。候选对抗样本在当前模型下进行评估，根据其对良性参考的威胁程度被选择，并用于自适应调整分布；策略参数在各训练轮次之间得以保留。为避免锚定在被误分类的干净样本上，我们引入（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出了进化式不确定性感知分布对抗训练（EvoUAD-AT），通过在对抗锚点周围维护实例级的对抗特征统计搜索分布并进行进化式威胁选择，以缓解单点对抗训练忽略对抗变异性的问题，从而提升模型的鲁棒泛化能力。
en_tdlr: Proposes EvoUAD-AT, which maintains an instance-wise evolutionary search distribution over adversarial feature statistics with uncertainty-aware, fitness-based selection to address the limitations of pointwise adversarial training and improve robust generalization.
